_about: Public-domain James Chalmers (1841-1901, London Missionary Society, Rarotonga and New Guinea, killed on Goaribari) for the Word Hoard: Work and Adventure in New Guinea, with W. Wyatt Gill (1885), Adventures in New Guinea (1886), Pioneering in New Guinea (1887) and Pioneering in New Guinea 1877-1894 (Revell), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Not Thomas Chalmers, who has his own shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jchalmers-adventures: Adventures in New Guinea (London: Religious Tract Society, 1886)
